title: 5GS mobility management in WB-N1 mode for IoT

entities.name: WB-N1 mode
entities.description: Operating mode for UEs in category CE, supporting either CE mode A or CE mode B.

entities.name: CE mode B
entities.description: Enhanced coverage mode supported by UEs operating in WB-N1 mode, subject to network restrictions.

entities.name: Enhanced coverage restriction
entities.description: Network indication whether use of enhanced coverage is restricted for the UE.

entities.name: CE mode B restriction
entities.description: Network indication whether CE mode B is restricted for the UE.

entities.name: NAS timer for WB-N1/CE mode
entities.description: Timer value from table 10.2.1 (UE) or table 10.2.2 (AMF), applied when enhanced coverage or CE mode B is not restricted.

entities.name: UE usage setting
entities.description: UE configuration indicating operational preference; must not be 'voice centric' for CE mode B applicability.

entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function; stores UE's CE mode B support and calculates NAS timer values when conditions are met.

entities.name: NAS procedure
entities.description: Non-Access Stratum procedure during which NAS timer values are calculated at start and not re-calculated until completion, restart, or abortion.

relations.description: CE mode B applicability requires UE usage setting not to be 'voice centric'.
If enhanced coverage is not restricted, UE/AMF applies NAS timer value for WB-N1/CE mode.
If CE mode B is not restricted, UE/AMF applies NAS timer value for WB-N1/CE mode.
NAS timer value is calculated at start of a NAS procedure and not re-calculated until procedure completion, restart, or abortion.
AMF stores UE's CE mode B support indication from lower layers.
